Role Description

As Regional Head of Partner Sales, Asia, you’ll lead a team of Partner Sales Managers and build the distributor and reseller relationships that bring Dropbox solutions to customers across the region.

Based in Singapore, you’ll own the team’s commercial performance across new business, expansion and retention. You’ll set market priorities, shape partner coverage and guide where the team focuses its effort. Alongside delivering results, you’ll coach and develop sales talent, helping the team build the capability and confidence to grow the business.

You’ll work with regional and global leaders to turn your market insight into action and influence Dropbox’s wider partner strategy. This is an opportunity to combine regional commercial ownership with people leadership, making decisions that strengthen customer relationships and build a productive, sustainable partner business.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Asia’s partner sales strategy, translating business goals into market priorities, partner segmentation, team coverage and investment recommendations.
  • Own the team’s performance against new-business, expansion and retention targets, establishing reliable forecasting and taking action to address pipeline risks and performance gaps.
  • Lead, coach and develop the Partner Sales Manager team, setting clear expectations, retaining talent, addressing underperformance fairly and building succession plans for critical responsibilities.
  • Ensure the team develops and executes joint business plans with partners, strengthens partner sales capability and establishes accountability for agreed actions and commercial outcomes.
  • Build relationships with senior distributor and reseller stakeholders, support complex negotiations and resolve escalations, balancing customer needs, partner economics and Dropbox’s commercial objectives.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions, Finance and Revenue Operations to align priorities, clarify ownership and secure support for the region’s highest-value opportunities.
  • Improve team productivity and commercial effectiveness through better processes, reliable data and the thoughtful use of approved AI and automation, validating results before scaling successful approaches.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated success leading a quota-carrying partner or channel sales team across multiple Asian markets, with clear accountability for commercial results.
  • Experience growing a B2B technology business through distributors and reseller partners, with a strong understanding of partner incentives, margins and recurring revenue models.
  • Strong sales execution and forecasting capability, with evidence of improving pipeline quality, conversion, expansion or retention through a team.
  • Ability to translate regional market insight into a practical commercial strategy, making sound decisions about market priorities, partner coverage, team capacity and investment recommendations.
  • Experience building senior partner relationships and navigating complex commercial negotiations, competing interests and customer or partner escalations.
  • A track record of coaching, developing and retaining sales talent, managing performance fairly and adapting team responsibilities or ways of working to business needs.
  • Ability to influence regional and global stakeholders, build clear commercial cases and secure cross-functional alignment across markets with competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a multi-product SaaS or subscription software business through channel partners.
  • Experience adapting partner models and sales approaches across markets with different levels of maturity.
  • Experience building scalable partner enablement programmes that improve partner capability, commercial performance and customer outcomes.
  • Experience introducing technology or AI-enabled workflows that deliver measurable improvements in sales productivity or team performance.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
